summary: TOC's third In Focus session featured Anisha Parikh (StarterSky), whose 3-4 month entrepreneurship accelerator costs INR 75,000 (group) or INR 90,000 (individual) plus tax, and Kshitij Garg (Estero Education), who returned to detail New Zealand visa specifics -- a roughly 92% average approval rate over the last 15 years, and a guaranteed 3-year post-study work visa with no employer sponsorship required for Bachelor's or Master's graduates.
keyInsights: StarterSky pricing: INR 75,000 (group track) or INR 90,000 (individual track), plus tax.
Estero's cited New Zealand visa approval rate: ~92% average over the last 15 years.
New Zealand's 3-year post-study work visa is guaranteed for Bachelor's/Master's graduates with no employer sponsorship needed.
